description: This PHP class 'PackageGenerator' generates and updates Drupal metapackages based on composer.lock files, managing JSON composer files for different Drupal project configurations.

classes.name: PackageGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and updating Drupal metapackages based on composer.lock files, including methods for building, encoding, and writing JSON composer files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PackageGenerator with the base directory for generated projects.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate Drupal's metapackages when composer.lock is updated, utilizing various builders.

methods.name: builders
methods.description: Returns a list of builder classes used to create different metapackages.

methods.name: generateMetapackage
methods.description: Generates a single metapackage JSON file if there are changes, and writes it to disk.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Utility static method to encode JSON data in a consistent, pretty-printed format.
